# frozen_string_literal: true
require 'json'
require 'securerandom'
require 'logger'

module MessageQueue
  class TenantIsolation
    ALLOWED_TENANT_CHARS = /\A[a-zA-Z0-9_\-\.]+\z/

    def initialize
      @logger = Logger.new($stdout)
      @tenant_queues = {}
      @tenant_permissions = {}
      @message_handlers = {}
    end

    def register_tenant(tenant_id, permissions = {})
      unless valid_tenant_id?(tenant_id)
        raise ArgumentError, "Invalid tenant ID format"
      end
      @tenant_queues[tenant_id] = []
      @tenant_permissions[tenant_id] = permissions
      @logger.info("Registered tenant: #{tenant_id}")
    end

    def register_handler(event_type, &block)
      @message_handlers[event_type] = block
    end

    def publish_message(sender_tenant, target_tenant, message)
      unless @tenant_queues.key?(sender_tenant)
        raise SecurityError, "Unknown sender tenant: #{sender_tenant}"
      end

      normalized_target = normalize_tenant_id(target_tenant)

      unless authorized_to_send?(sender_tenant, normalized_target)
        raise SecurityError, "Tenant #{sender_tenant} not authorized to send to #{normalized_target}"
      end

      envelope = build_envelope(sender_tenant, normalized_target, message)
      deliver_message(envelope)
    end

    def consume_messages(tenant_id)
      unless @tenant_queues.key?(tenant_id)
        raise SecurityError, "Unknown tenant: #{tenant_id}"
      end

      messages = @tenant_queues[tenant_id].dup
      @tenant_queues[tenant_id].clear
      messages
    end

    private

    def valid_tenant_id?(tenant_id)
      return false if tenant_id.nil? || tenant_id.empty?
      return false if tenant_id.length > 64
      tenant_id.match?(ALLOWED_TENANT_CHARS)
    end

    def normalize_tenant_id(tenant_id)
      # Normalize Unicode to catch homograph attempts
      # First, encode to UTF-8 and apply NFKC normalization
      normalized = tenant_id.encode('UTF-8')
      normalized = unicode_nfkc_normalize(normalized)
      # Strip any remaining non-ASCII after normalization
      normalized = normalized.gsub(/[^\x20-\x7E]/, '')
      normalized.downcase.strip
    end

    def unicode_nfkc_normalize(str)
      # Apply compatibility decomposition followed by canonical composition
      # This handles common homoglyphs like fullwidth chars, etc.
      result = str.chars.map do |char|
        codepoint = char.ord
        # Map fullwidth ASCII variants (U+FF01-U+FF5E) to ASCII (U+0021-U+007E)
        if codepoint >= 0xFF01 && codepoint <= 0xFF5E
          (codepoint - 0xFEE0).chr('UTF-8')
        # Map Cyrillic homoglyphs to Latin equivalents
        elsif cyrillic_to_latin(codepoint)
          cyrillic_to_latin(codepoint)
        else
          char
        end
      end.join
      result
    end

    def cyrillic_to_latin(codepoint)
      # Map visually similar Cyrillic characters to Latin
      mapping = {
        0x0410 => 'A', # А -> A
        0x0412 => 'B', # В -> B  
        0x0421 => 'C', # С -> C
        0x0415 => 'E', # Е -> E
        0x041D => 'H', # Н -> H
        0x041A => 'K', # К -> K
        0x041C => 'M', # М -> M
        0x041E => 'O', # О -> O
        0x0420 => 'P', # Р -> P
        0x0422 => 'T', # Т -> T
        0x0425 => 'X', # Х -> X
        0x0430 => 'a', # а -> a
        0x0435 => 'e', # е -> e
        0x043E => 'o', # о -> o
        0x0440 => 'p', # р -> p
        0x0441 => 'c', # с -> c
        0x0445 => 'x', # х -> x
        0x0443 => 'y', # у -> y
      }
      mapping[codepoint]
    end

    def authorized_to_send?(sender, target)
      perms = @tenant_permissions[sender]
      return false unless perms
      return true if perms[:can_send_to] == :all
      return true if perms[:can_send_to]&.include?(target)
      false
    end

    def build_envelope(sender, target, message)
      {
        id: SecureRandom.uuid,
        sender: sender,
        target: target,
        payload: message,
        timestamp: Time.now.utc.iso8601
      }
    end

    def deliver_message(envelope)
      target = envelope[:target]
      # Route to target tenant's queue
      if @tenant_queues.key?(target)
        @tenant_queues[target] << envelope
        invoke_handler('message.delivered', envelope)
      else
        # Target not found - check if it matches after lookup normalization
        resolved = resolve_tenant_lookup(target)
        if resolved && @tenant_queues.key?(resolved)
          @tenant_queues[resolved] << envelope
          invoke_handler('message.delivered', envelope)
        else
          invoke_handler('message.undeliverable', envelope)
        end
      end
    end

    def resolve_tenant_lookup(target_id)
      # Secondary lookup: find tenant by case-insensitive prefix match
      # This handles cases where normalization produces slightly different results
      @tenant_queues.keys.find do |registered|
        registered.downcase == target_id.downcase ||
          confusable_match?(registered, target_id)
      end
    end

    def confusable_match?(str1, str2)
      # Check if two strings are confusable (visual similarity)
      skeleton(str1) == skeleton(str2)
    end

    def skeleton(str)
      # Reduce string to its "skeleton" for confusable detection
      str.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9]/, '')
    end

    def invoke_handler(event_type, data)
      handler = @message_handlers[event_type]
      handler&.call(data)
    end
  end

  class Consumer
    def initialize(isolation_layer)
      @isolation = isolation_layer
    end

    def process_incoming(raw_message)
      parsed = JSON.parse(raw_message, symbolize_names: true)
      sender = parsed[:sender_tenant]
      target = parsed[:target_tenant]
      payload = parsed[:payload]

      @isolation.publish_message(sender, target, payload)
    rescue JSON::ParserError => e
      { error: 'Invalid message format', details: e.message }
    rescue SecurityError => e
      { error: 'Authorization failed', details: e.message }
    end
  end
end
